gaps.category: Municipal and sectoral licensing of street/market traders and food vendors (category 19, not_reached)
gaps.first_search: licencia de funcionamiento mercado de abastos comerciantes ITSE renovación Ley 28976 municipalidad 2026
gaps.why: Peru has among the largest informal micro-trade populations in Latin America (mercados de abastos, ambulantes, comedores, ferias). Each municipality requires a licencia de funcionamiento and ITSE/Defensa Civil renewals, and the municipal Ley 28976 / TUO 2023 regime plus the sanitary registers for food sellers are unexamined. Only money changers were covered.

gaps.category: Defensa Civil ITSE / inspección técnica de seguridad en edificaciones for small premises
gaps.first_search: ITSE renovación certificado Defensa Civil DS 002-2018-PCM plazo vigencia bodegas restaurantes 2026
gaps.why: ITSE (DS 002-2018-PCM) and its periodic renewal apply to nearly every hostal, restaurant, clinic, school and shop. This is a recurring mandatory file for tens of thousands of small premises, and no candidate in the ledger addresses it.

gaps.category: Electronic invoicing and SUNAT regime obligations for micro-firms (RUS/RER/RMT), e.g. new comprobantes, PLE or SIRE thresholds, GRE guía de remisión electrónica
gaps.first_search: SUNAT guía de remisión electrónica remitente obligados MYPE RUS cronograma 2026 resolución de superintendencia
gaps.why: Only K11 (SIRE for accountants) was examined and rejected. The duty falling on MYPE sole traders (the RUS to RMT migration, the obligation to issue electronic guías de remisión for transport of goods, and the 2025-2027 SUNAT deadlines) is a different buyer group and was not screened.

gaps.category: Solid-waste and recycling informal collectors (recicladores) and municipal segregation programmes (Ley 29419 / DL 1501 / RS)
gaps.first_search: registro recicladores formalizados asociaciones SIGERSOL Ley 29419 reglamento reporte municipal 2026
gaps.why: Recicladores formalised in associations must register with the municipal Registro de Recicladores and report to MINAM's SIGERSOL. The thousands of small associations and the household and commercial segregation duty were not screened, and K03 covers only hazardous-waste operators.

gaps.category: Private schools, academies, CETPRO and nurseries (SUNEDU / MINEDU / UGEL registration and annual reports)
gaps.first_search: colegios privados UGEL reporte SIAGIE comunicación de costos pensiones Ley 26549 obligaciones 2026 Registro de Instituciones Educativas Privadas
gaps.why: Peru has a very large number of small private schools and academias that must file with UGEL (Registro de Instituciones Educativas Privadas, Ley 26549 / DL 882, annual cost and fee notifications under DS 005-2021-MINEDU, SIAGIE enrolment reporting). Childcare was marked unverified and only touched in passing, and this broader education group was never screened.

gaps.category: Transport and mototaxi / taxi formalization and operator registers at municipalities (ATU, SUTRAN, municipal permits) beyond the colectivo item
gaps.first_search: AFOCAT SOAT digital obligatoriedad vehículos CITV revisión técnica vencimiento mototaxis ordenanza municipal 2026
gaps.why: Mototaxi (Ley 27189), urban taxi and ATU Lima/Callao permits, together with the SOAT/AFOCAT/CITV vehicle compliance cycle, hit hundreds of thousands of owner-drivers. Coverage only mentioned colectivos and trucking GPS, and the AFOCAT insurance-association regime was not examined.

candidates.buyer: Small gold buyers, comercializadores and small plantas de beneficio (about 12,418 RECPO registrants in Feb 2025; 2,328 plantas in the REINFO after the Aug 2025 clean-up)
candidates.evidence: https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/api/visor_html/2471915-1 (fetched: art. 11 data list; the text creates no purchase register); https://energiminas.com/2025/02/27/en-el-peru-existen-mas-de-12-mil-comercializadores-de-oro-cifra-excesiva-que-debe-transparentarse (fetched: 12,418 RECPO registrants, regulation pending, an expert thinks only about 2,000 should remain); https://www.cuatrecasas.com/es/latam/publico/art/reinfo-amplian-plazo-2026; https://proactivo.com.pe/minem-propone-reglamento-para-el-ingreso-y-permanencia-al-registro-especial-de-comercializadores-y-procesadores-de-oro-recpo/
candidates.existing: Competitor search 'software registro de compras de oro comercializador planta de beneficio sistema trazabilidad' found no commercial product. Only articles about regulatory gaps and a Minem pilot traceability system (energiminas.com/?p=38092, details not read).
candidates.known_note: Same sector as K02 (cyanide/mercury register) and K04 (mine contractor accreditation) but a different buyer (gold buyers) and a different duty (seller verification).
candidates.name: Gold buyer / comercializador purchase-verification and register pack (RECPO, DL 1107 art. 11)
candidates.trigger: Ley 32537 (Dec 2025) changed DL 1107 art. 11: the buyer must verify the seller's RUC, identity and address, a valid Código Único de Concesión, the Autorización de Explotación, and a current REINFO or similar status, and check authenticity in the official systems. The REINFO formalization period ends 31 Dec 2026 or when the Ley MAPE takes effect, which forces buyers to re-check every supplier. DS 012-2012-EM older rule requires an electronic register of each gold purchase. The RECPO regulation and the Minem traceability pilot are still pending.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the DS 012-2012-EM purchase register is still in force. Whether the RECPO regulation was issued after the 2021 draft. Status of the Minem pilot system and whether it replaces private tools. Whether the REINFO cut-off will be extended again. Many buyers are informal and unlikely to pay. Who inspects them (SUNAT, Minem).

candidates.buyer: Small jewellers and traders of jewellery, precious metals and stones
candidates.existing: No competitor search run (budget). Generic SPLAFT consultancy is likely.
candidates.known_note: Related to K05 (SPLAFT-in-a-box for money changers and pawn shops), but a different buyer group.
candidates.name: Compliance pack for jewellers and precious-metal traders (UIF-Perú)
candidates.trigger: Res SBS 789-2018 (the current AML rule) lists the jewellery, precious metals and stones trade as sujetos obligados under UIF-Perú supervision. They need a compliance officer, a transaction register and suspicious-activity reporting. The SBS publishes sanctions.
candidates.unchecked: Exact thresholds and whether jewellers under size limits are exempt. Registration channel (UIF register of sujetos obligados). Competitor products. How many small jewellers are actually enforced.

candidates.buyer: Asociaciones, fundaciones, comités and IPREDA/ONGD receiving foreign donations
candidates.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
candidates.existing: No competitor search run (budget). Accountants and legal firms probably handle it by hand.
candidates.name: Annual beneficial-owner and APCI filing for small associations and ONG
candidates.trigger: SUNAT requires associations, foundations and committees to file the beneficial-owner declaration (DL 1372, DS 003-2019-EF; Informe 128-2020). A secondary source says it is yearly when the board changes (unverified). APCI requires the Informe Anual and Plan Anual in SIGCTI; the 2025 report was extended to 30 Jun 2026 (RDE 058-2026/APCI-DE); not filing blocks the IGV refund. Ley 32301 (Apr 2025) changed the APCI framework.
candidates.unchecked: Number of buyers. Willingness to pay. Whether the free SIGCTI and SUNAT forms are easy enough. Whether a Registro de Entidades Perceptoras de Donaciones renewal adds work. SUNAT Registro de Entidades Exoneradas (the lpderecho result suggests removal risk).

candidates.buyer: JASS, rural water boards, plus the municipal areas that supervise them (thousands of boards, mostly volunteers)
candidates.existing: No competitor search run (budget). SUNASS/OTASS likely have free tools; not checked.
candidates.name: Rural water committee (JASS) compliance and fee kit
candidates.trigger: TUO of the Reglamento de Calidad de la Prestación (RCD 058-2023-SUNASS-CD) requires chlorine monitoring records and disinfection registers; the cuota familiar must be approved yearly by the assembly using SUNASS's method; the municipal organizaciones comunales register applies. A thesis found many JASS non-compliant.
candidates.unchecked: Whether JASS must report to a regulator and how often. Willingness to pay (very low). Whether OTASS or SUNASS tools already cover it. Offline use and connectivity.

candidates.name: Domestic worker employer compliance

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K07. Duties confirmed: Ley 31047 and DS 009-2021-TR, T-Registro alta/baja at SUNAT, MTPE Registro de Trabajadores del Hogar, written contract, SUNAFIL protocol v2 (RS 202-2022-SUNAFIL). Official 'Verifica tu Chamba' check exists.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No Peruvian scrap-dealer register or purchase-log duty found in one search. SUNAT bienes fiscalizados regime covers chemicals, not scrap. Only related item is chatarreo of vehicles (see cat 5). Nothing.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawn and money-changer duty is already K05 (SBS Registro de casas de cambio, préstamos y empeños; Res SBS 789-2018). Second-hand mobile phone resellers touched by RENTESEG (DL 1338, DS 017-2025-IN) but the duty mainly falls on importers and operators: weak candidate C10.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Two new candidates: gold buyers/RECPO under DL 1107 art. 11 as changed by Ley 32537 (C1), and jewellery and precious-metal traders as SBS 789-2018 sujetos obligados (C2). RECPO had 12,418 registrants in Feb 2025; the REINFO deadline of 31 Dec 2026 is near.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: DL 1214 and DS 016-2019-IN (8 chapters, 24 articles) govern vehicle and parts crime prevention, but I could not read the articles. lpderecho returned 403 and vlex is paywalled. Obligations on parts dealers are unconfirmed (C11, unverified). Chatarreo regime: DS 028-2011-MTC, DS 016-2021-MTC, DS 014-2024-MTC, mostly state and depot facing.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Peru: Certificado Sanitario de Tránsito Interno from SENASA is required to move livestock (2018 Cajamarca and 2014 Puno sources, old). No current register for traders or fairs confirmed. Search results were mostly Argentine. Nothing usable.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: DS 015-2012-AG sanitary slaughter regulation. Camal needs SENASA authorization with HACCP, good-practice manual and traceability plan (Jaén Nov 2025 case). Three camal categories. The buyers are mostly municipalities. Weak candidate C7.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Ley 26305 only requires a voluntary registro codificado, and associations report hive counts annually. No SENASA apiary register found. Nothing.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Only old rules found: DS 015-98-AG, Res 031/98/AG/SENASA (registration of distributors and sellers, responsible vet), RD 1257-2007. No current recipe or antimicrobial-sales log rule found. Folded into agroveterinaria candidate C5 (unverified for vets).

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: ANA keeps a Registro de Consultores y Empresas Perforadoras de Agua Subterránea (RATN-ANA-001-2021). RJ 010-2025-ANA (Jan 2025) added art. 32-A, which waives steps for family farmers up to 10 ha. No periodic extraction report found. Weak (C12).

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: EO-RS register at MINAM (indefinite validity, vehicles listed) and hazardous-waste manifests: K03 covers this. Rules for septic sludge haulers could not be located; unclear whether they need EO-RS. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: No Peruvian mandatory periodic lift or boiler inspection regime found. Lift maintenance is a condominium matter under Ley 27157 regulation arts. 137-138. Results were Spanish. Nothing.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: JASS: municipal register of organizaciones comunales, annual cuota familiar by SUNASS methodology, chlorine records (TUO RCPSS, RCD 058-2023-SUNASS-CD). One thesis found many JASS non-compliant. Candidate C3 (low willingness to pay).

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: DS 001-2015-MINAGRI: dealers must sell only SENASA-registered products; categories Ia/Ib need an agronomist prescription. SENASA runs inspections (2024). No sales-book duty confirmed. Fertiliser rules not searched. Candidate C5.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: RENEEIL at MTPE (Ley 27626, DS 003-2002-TR). The exclusive corporate purpose rule and the risk that a worker moves onto the user firm's payroll are real. This overlaps group B cat 26, so I did no deeper screening. Note only (C9, weak).

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Ley 26298 and DS 03-94-SA (amended by DS 031-2021-SA): sanitary authorization of indefinite validity. No periodic reporting duty found. Nothing.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Associations, foundations and committees must file the SUNAT beneficial-owner declaration (Informe SUNAT 128-2020). IPREDA/ONGD must file the APCI Informe Anual (extended to 30 Jun 2026 by RDE 058-2026/APCI-DE). Ley 32301 (Apr 2025) reworked APCI rules. Candidate C4. Halal and kosher: not applicable, no Peruvian market.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Taxi colectivo formalization: Ley 31096, with a committee opinion to extend the deadline from 24 Dec 2027 to 2031 (not confirmed as law). Trucking: GPS to SUTRAN since 2017, SUNAT GRE-Transportista, Res 000108-2026/SUNAT in force 1 Jun 2026. These are covered by free state tools or telematics vendors. Weak (C8).

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers are K05. I spent no search on street vendors or market traders (budget). Municipal licensing is likely local and fragmented.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Driving schools: MTC authorization (DS 040-2008-MTC), biometric record of the 6-hour course for professional drivers, Sutran supervision (C6, weak). Childcare: Lima Ordenanza 2625 / DA 018 (19 Dec 2025) covers municipal CIM/GIM, and I could not find a private-provider regime (C13, unverified). Wildlife zoocriaderos: SERFOR libro de operaciones (C14). Tattoo studios, small food producers, hunting outfitters: not searched.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Osinergmin RCD 60-2026-OS/CD makes daily inventory registration in the PVO mandatory for fuel retail outlets from 15 May 2026, a condition for SCOP purchase orders (K01/K13 known). New angle: GLP retail shops (locales de venta de GLP) have separate duties (price reporting via PRICE, FISE voucher redemption, RCD 75-2025-OS/CD multi-brand sales), and the PVO GLP inventory module (RCD 089-2022-OS/CD) covers envasadoras, gasocentros and minimum-stock agents. Osinergmin suspended 27 unregistered GLP shops in Espinar. Official PVO is free web.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K09 (EUDR, MIDAGRI Agrodigital) and K12 (rice mill IVAP). No mandatory register of coffee/cocoa acopiadores found. EUDR date reported by MIDAGRI as postponed to 30 Dec 2026. One unverified single-source lead: DS 015-2026-EF (reglamento of Ley 32434) reportedly removes the 'acto de representación' used by coffee cooperatives; not confirmed. NTP 208.040:2026 cocoa is voluntary.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Coopac regime: SBS RS 01690-2026 (24 Jun 2026) amends accounting manuals and Reports 3/3-A for levels 1-3; provisions deadline extended to 31 Dec 2029; RS 01586-2026 on Mecanismo de Identificacion de Titularidades Financieras tags Coopac; level 1 files quarterly financial statements. No level-1-specific AML rule found. Core-banking vendors for Coopacs likely exist but not checked.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: SUSALUD RS 000143-2026-SUSALUD/SUP sets 31 Oct 2026 as the deadline for private IPRESS (formerly SITEDS Cliente) to move to Acredita Salud; 386 of 508 had migrated. Platform is free from SUSALUD. Also RENIPRESS registration and libro de reclamaciones duties, nothing dated 2026. Data protection (DS 016-2024-JUS) applies to clinics.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: SUNAT RS 000135-2026 (published 17 Jul 2026, effective around 1 Sep 2026) requires a daily operations register and loss/spill reporting for chemical inputs under Ley 32412 arts 8-9 (K02 known). Small miners in formalization are reportedly exempt from the consolidated monthly communication. No 2026 controlled-drug (estupefacientes/psicotropicos) register news found; K08 already rejected.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Nothing new for periodic reporting. SUCAMEC DL 1213 / DS 005-2023-IN, draft training directive RS 00065-2026-SUCAMEC (consultation), fines 2-10 UIT; RENEEIL registry for labour intermediation; DS 001-2022-TR core-business outsourcing ban is legally contested. SUNAFIL Directive 001-2026-SUNAFIL/DINI audits planilla electronica compliance of REINFO holders.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: REINFO runs to 31 Dec 2026 (Ley 32537) or until the MAPE law; 31,610 registered at 20 Apr 2026 (23,861 valid, 7,749 suspended); the executive plans to send the MAPE bill by 15 Oct 2026. MINEM offers free IGAFOM virtual system and assistance campaigns. SUNAFIL planilla audits of REINFO holders. SUCAMEC explosives: no reporting rule found. No construction-contractor register found.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: New: SBS Res 01015-2026 (8 Apr 2026) new SPLAFT regime for casinos, slot rooms and online betting; DS 008-2026-JUS adds unregulated leasing firms as UIF reporting entities. Notaries report ROS to UIF; agente inmobiliario register (Ley 29080, DS 010-2016-VIVIENDA) unchanged, no 2026 change found.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Nothing new. Guest register duty under DS 001-2015-MINCETUR (amended by DS 005-2021-MINCETUR, minors rule per Ley 30802); no 2026 decree on short-term rentals or platforms found; 2023 bill on a national platform registry, status unknown. No national tourism levy found.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K06 (timber Libro de Operaciones, SERFOR e-libro in MC-SNIFFS) and K09 (EUDR). SANIPES export health certificates go through VUCE (3 working days); no new mandatory digital platform for small exporters found. SANIPES e-notifications to plants exist.

coverage.category: 31. Gaming: casinos, slot-machine rooms, betting (country-specific)
coverage.found: SBS Res 01015-2026: SPLAFT with 13 components, Registro de Operaciones (US$2,500 reference), ROS in 24 hours via ROSEL, fines up to 8 UIT; MINCETUR DGJCMT supervises; slot machines already connect via SUCTR. Sanctions news: 30 gaming-room owners fined.

coverage.category: 32. Small-scale mining formalization: REINFO to MAPE transition (country-specific)
coverage.found: Ley 32537 extends REINFO to 31 Dec 2026; MAPE bill and Ley 32213 reglamento (Sistema Interoperable) pending; SUNAFIL Directive 001-2026; free MINEM IGAFOM and Formalizacion Responsable assistance (1,185 miners in June 2026). No private software found.

coverage.category: 33. Personal data protection duties for SMEs (DS 016-2024-JUS, in force 30 Mar 2025) (country-specific)
coverage.found: Registration of data banks, data protection officer (longer deadline, exact date not confirmed), 48-hour incident reporting; ANPD fined over S/ 11.3 million in 2025 and inspected 760 entities. Generic across all SMEs, so likely out of scope; the Transitional Provisions were not read.

coverage.category: 34. Elderly residential care centres (MIMP accreditation) (country-specific)
coverage.found: MIMP identified 388 CEAPAM, 355 of them residential (June 2026); needs municipal licence then MIMP accreditation under Ley 30490. No 2025-2026 adaptation deadline found. Small buyer pool.

coverage.category: 35. Artisanal fishing and landing sites (PRODUCE/SANIPES) (country-specific)
coverage.found: Artisanal formalization closed to new applications on 31 Jul 2023, with the resolution period running to 31 Jul 2026 (pota and perico); draft rule from Jan 2026 would lapse permits after 2 years of inactivity (status unconfirmed); SANIPES sanitary habilitation of 4,721 boats. No logging/reporting software lead.

coverage.category: 36. FISE social energy programme: GLP voucher redemption agents (country-specific)
coverage.found: GLP shops registered as FISE agents must keep a redemption notebook, display signage (RCD 138-2012-OS/CD) and report to the electricity distributor; digital vouchers settle automatically at the terminal. DU 002-2026 adds a one-off S/10 voucher through 31 Dec 2026. Sources are partly old.

coverage.category: 37. Explosives and detonators handlers (SUCAMEC) (country-specific)
coverage.found: Only enforcement news (seizure of 25,000 detonators bound for an unauthorised polvorin in Cajamarca; destruction authorisations). No periodic reporting rule found in one search.

coverage.category: 38. Chemical inputs RCBF users under Ley 32412 (country-specific)
coverage.found: RCBF registration must be renewed or the user cannot operate; SUNAT RS 135-2026 daily register. Same duty as K02; user population beyond miners (distributors, transporters) not quantified.

coverage.category: 39. Newly added UIF reporting entities: unregulated leasing firms (DS 008-2026-JUS) (country-specific)
coverage.found: DS 008-2026-JUS adds leasing companies outside Ley 26702 as sujetos obligados. Thin: number of firms and deadlines not checked.

coverage.category: 40. Coffee cooperatives under Ley 32434 / DS 015-2026-EF (country-specific)
coverage.found: Single-source claim that the DS 015-2026-EF reglamento removes the acto de representacion used by coffee cooperatives to collect grain from smallholders; entry into force and effect not confirmed.
